# VivaAge (full)

> Expanded LLM context for VivaAge: product surfaces, discovery documents, and public API notes for Vietnamese healthy-aging education.

Use this file when a larger context window is available. Prefer `/llms.txt` for a shorter overview. Educational use only — not medical, financial, or legal advice.

## Docs

- [llms.txt](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/llms.txt): Short curated overview
- [OpenAPI](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/openapi.json): Public API paths and operations
- [API catalog](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset (`application/linkset+json`)
- [auth.md](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/auth.md): Anonymous session registration for agents
- [OAuth protected resource](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): RFC 9728 resource metadata
- [AI catalog](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): ARD capability manifest (`specVersion`, host, entries)
- [ARD manifest](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/.well-known/ard.json): Same capability manifest at the current well-known path
- [OAuth authorization server](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server): AS metadata with `agent_auth`
- [Agent skills index](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Skills discovery index
- [VivaAge overview skill](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/.well-known/agent-skills/vivaage-overview/SKILL.md): Product overview skill markdown
- [VivaAge auth skill](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/.well-known/agent-skills/vivaage-auth/SKILL.md): Auth skill markdown
- [MCP server card](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): MCP transport and tools summary
- [MCP endpoint](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/mcp): Minimal streamable HTTP / JSON-RPC tools
- [Sitemap](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/sitemap.xml): Indexable routes, library lessons, blog posts
- [Agent discovery notes](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/llms.txt): Start here if this file is too long

## Product

- [Home](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/): Landing page with brand rationale and CTAs
- [Readiness assessment](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/danh-gia): Health, finance, caregiving questionnaire
- [30-day plan](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/ke-hoach): Weekly action plan after assessment
- [Ask VivaAge](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/hoi): Grounded educational chat
- [Library](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/thu-vien): Educational articles by category
- [Today](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/hom-nay): Momentum and today’s actions
- [Motivational blog](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/blog): Daily encouragement
- [Profile & privacy](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/ho-so): Privacy and disclaimer

## Library examples

- [Emergency contacts](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/thu-vien/lien-he-khan-cap): Build a household emergency contact list
- [Fall prevention](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/thu-vien/phong-nga): Reduce fall risk at home
- [Blood pressure at home](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/thu-vien/theo-doi-huyet-ap): Track blood pressure for clinic visits
- [Emergency fund](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/thu-vien/quy-du-phong): Start a simple contingency fund
- [Aging documents](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/thu-vien/giay-to-tuoi-gia): Organize important papers

## API notes

- [Health](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/api/health): Liveness JSON
- [Meta](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/api/v1/meta): Disclaimer, versions, example questions
- [Session](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/api/v1/session): POST to create anonymous session + CSRF
- [Library API](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/api/v1/library): List active lessons

## Optional

- [robots.txt](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/robots.txt): Allow/Disallow and Content Signals
- [Atom feed](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/feed.xml): Full-text blog feed for crawlers
- [Brand identity notes](https://vivaage.orangecloud.vn/llms.txt): Brand meaning is summarized in the short llms.txt blockquote and intro
